Sandbox_ETW_AnemicBleedingDamage_tooltip: Additional health lost from each actively bleeding, unstemmed body part every minute. Head and neck wounds receive twice this amount.
Sandbox_ETW_BadTeethPainChance_tooltip: Chance that completing an eating action causes head pain.
Sandbox_ETW_BadTeethMaxPain: Bad Teeth pain for a full portion
Sandbox_ETW_BadTeethMaxPain_tooltip: Head pain added when an entire portion is eaten. Smaller portions scale this amount proportionally.
Sandbox_ETW_BlissfulUnhappinessReduction: Percentage of the full unhappiness scale removed each minute. Since unhappiness ranges from 0 to 100, 1%% removes 1 point per minute.
Sandbox_ETW_BlissfulBoredomReductionPerM: Percentage of the full boredom scale removed each minute. Since boredom ranges from 0 to 100, 1%% removes 1 point per minute.
Sandbox_ETW_ButterfingersChanceOneIn_too: A larger value makes the once-per-minute roll less likely to drop held items. Carried weight, running, sprinting, All Thumbs, and Dextrous modify the chance.
Sandbox_ETW_HardyExtraEndurancePercent_t: Size of Hardy's hidden endurance reserve relative to the normal endurance bar.
Sandbox_ETW_HardyTransferPerMinute_toolt: Amount of endurance moved between the normal bar and Hardy's hidden reserve each minute.
Sandbox_ETW_IdealWeightLowerThreshold_to: Below this weight, positive calorie gains use the underweight multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_IdealWeightUpperThreshold_to: Above this weight, positive calorie gains use the overweight multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_IdealWeightUnderMultiplier_t: Multiplier applied to positive calorie gains at or below the lower threshold.
Sandbox_ETW_IdealWeightOverMultiplier_to: Multiplier applied to positive calorie gains at or above the upper threshold.
Sandbox_ETW_PackMouseWeight: Pack Mouse penalty per point of Strength
Sandbox_ETW_PackMouseWeight_tooltip: Amount of maximum carrying capacity removed per point of Strength.
Sandbox_ETW_QuickRestRecoveryMultiplier_: Multiplier applied to natural endurance recovery while sitting on the ground or furniture.
Sandbox_ETW_WellFittedWeightReduction_to: Percentage by which worn clothing's actual weight is reduced.
Sandbox_ETW_WellFittedNegatesSpeedPenalt: When enabled, worn clothing cannot reduce running or combat speed.
Sandbox_ETW_AVClubSkill: AV Club Member Electrical Skill Requirement
Sandbox_ETW_AffinitySystemGainMultiplier: How much easier it is to gain perks that have Affinity System functionality (only affects perks you started with!). Setting it to 1 would mean that it doesn't make it easier to gain. Setting it to 2 means it'll take twice as fast to gain them. Setting it to 1.5 would make it 50%% faster, and so on. So if you start with a positive dynamic trait and later lose it, you'll get it back much faster. But it also affects negative traits!
Sandbox_ETW_AffinitySystemLoseDivider_to: How much harder it is to lose perks that have Affinity System functionality (only affects perks you started with!). Setting it to 1 would mean that it doesn't make it harder to lose. Setting it to 2 means you'll be twice as slow to lose them. Setting it to 1.5 would make it 50%% slower, and so on. So if you start with a positive trait that you can lose, it'll be much harder to lose it. But it also affects negative traits!
Sandbox_ETW_AffinitySystem_tooltip:
Defines if the Affinity System is enabled for some traits tied to systems and some complex ones (for example, Fear of Locations or Sleep System traits).
The Affinity system makes it easier to hold onto traits you picked during character creation, both negative and positive. With it enabled, you halve (modifiable) the speed at which you lose these traits, and double (also modifiable) the speed at which you earn these traits
Sandbox_ETW_AsthmaticCounter_tooltip: The value on the counter you should reach to lose the asthmatic trait. Running or exercising in cold temperatures decreases the counter; the colder it is, the faster the decrease. If you're outside, it decreases even faster. If you are a smoker, it decreases even faster. Additionally, being a smoker slowly decreases the counter when you run, even if the weather is fine. Reaching the counter removes the trait. The counter slowly increases by itself as long as you're not running or sprinting and breathing air warmer than 0 degrees Celsius. On top of that, it increases based on your Fitness level and current endurance level. Being a smoker halves the increase rate. Having the asthmatic trait halves it again
Sandbox_ETW_AxeThrowerKills: Axe Thrower Kills with Axes requirement
Sandbox_ETW_AxemanTrees_tooltip: The number of trees you have to cut down to get the Ax-pert trait
Sandbox_ETW_BaseballPlayerKills: Baseball Player Kills with Long Blunt requirement
Sandbox_ETW_BaseballPlayerSkill: Baseball Player Long Blunt Skill requirement
Sandbox_ETW_BladeEnthusiastKills: Blade Enthusiast Long Blade Kills requirement
Sandbox_ETW_BladeEnthusiastSkill: Blade Enthusiast Long Blade Skill requirement
Sandbox_ETW_BloodlustFromAnimalsMultipli: Multiplies how much killing or butchering an animal fills the Bloodlust meter compared to a point-blank zombie kill. Set to 0 to disable it. This does not directly increase Bloodlust progress
Sandbox_ETW_BloodlustMeterFillMultiplier: How fast you fill your bloodlust meter
Sandbox_ETW_BloodlustMeterMaxCapMultipli: By how much you can overfill your Bloodlust Meter. This is a multiplier. 2 means you can fill your Bloodlust Meter to 200%%, for example
Sandbox_ETW_BloodlustMoodleVisibilityHou: For how many hours the bloodlust moodle is visible after a nearby kill on a zombie
Sandbox_ETW_BloodlustMoodle_tooltip: If this option is disabled, the moodle won't show up. For single-player, leave this on and change moodles you see with Mod Options. If it's a server setting, players won't be able to enable the moodle client-sided
Sandbox_ETW_BloodlustMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies the effect of bloodlust by this value. By default, unhappiness, stress, and panic are each reduced by 4%% for each kill. This multiplier is applied to those 4%%. So setting this to 0.5 would make those stats reduced by 2%% instead
Sandbox_ETW_BloodlustProgress_tooltip: How much total bloodlust progress you need to get the trait. Be aware that you also lose bloodlust if this meter ever falls below 50%%. So if you set it low, it's going to be easy to earn but also easy to lose the perk. Progress is capped at 2x the Bloodlust Progress value
Sandbox_ETW_Bloodlust_tooltip: This allows you to gain a benefit by filling and maintaining a bloodlust meter. The bloodlust meter is soft-capped at 72 hours and can be filled by killing zombies. The closer the zombies are, the more quickly the meter will fill. When you're above half of the meter, every hour it will give you progress towards the bloodlust perk; when it's below, it'll remove progress. The bloodlust meter naturally decays by 1 every hour. Having bloodied clothes helps the process
Sandbox_ETW_BodyBiteContribution_tooltip: Severity assigned to each current bite. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and, if treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier. Any resulting wound infection is not counted separately.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyBurnContribution_tooltip: Severity assigned to each current burn. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and, if treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyDeepWoundContribution_to: Severity assigned to each current deep wound or stitched deep wound. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes for active deep wounds. The Healer System checks every minute and, if treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyFractureContribution_too: Severity assigned to each current fracture. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and, if splint treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyLacerationContribution_t: Severity assigned to each current laceration. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and, if treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyLodgedBulletContribution: Severity assigned to each currently lodged bullet. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its neglected-wound multiplier. This is counted in addition to any associated deep wound.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyLodgedGlassContribution_: Severity assigned to each currently lodged piece of glass. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its neglected-wound multiplier. This is counted in addition to any associated deep wound.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyScratchContribution_tool: Severity assigned to each current scratch. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and, if treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyworkEnthusiastRepairs_to: The percentage of car condition you have to repair to qualify for the perk. Works on every part of a car and is saved between all cars
Sandbox_ETW_BraverySystemKills_tooltip:
Here you set up how many kills you need to get to max out your bravery system. Melee kills count twice for progress. Progression is as follows: Cowardly -> Fear of Blood -> Pacifist -> Adrenaline Junkie -> Brave -> Desensitized
You need to have previous trait gone (if it's negative) or present (if it's positive) to earn/lose next trait In progression.
Amounts to reach each stage are as follows:
Cowardly: 10%% of max kills
Fear of Blood: 20%% of max kills
Pacifist: 30%% of max kills
Adrenaline Junkie: 40%% of max kills
Brave: 60%% of max kills
Desensitized: 100%% of max kills
Example: Max kills is set to 1000. You start with Cowardly. You need 100 kills to remove it. If you get 50 melee kills, it'll be removed. The same is true if you get 40 melee kills (x2 = 80 kills for the counter) and 20 firearms kills
Sandbox_ETW_BraverySystemRemovesOtherFea: Bravery System Removes Other Fear Perks
If enabled, getting desensitized through the Bravery system will also remove other fear perks like Pluviophile, Homichlophobia, Agoraphobic, and Claustrophobic, and prevent you from gaining them
Sandbox_ETW_BurglarSkill_tooltip: Mechanics + Electrical + Nimble. Please note that you need to have at least 2 levels in both Mechanics and Electrical
Sandbox_ETW_CatEyesCounter_tooltip: This allows you to gain points by seeing and observing squares within a certain radius of your character. The number of points you earn is influenced by factors such as the time of day, the darkness of the square, and whether you and the square are inside or outside. The more squares you see and the darker they are, the more points you will earn. Having Eagle Eyed doubles the gain. Making a kill at night triggers extra execution of function responsible for gaining progress (so instead of getting progress 1 time / minute you can get progress 3 times per minute, for example)
Sandbox_ETW_CookSkill: Keen Cook Cooking + Butchering Skill requirement
Sandbox_ETW_DelayedTraitsSystemDefaultDe: Default delay (in hours) for traits to appear/disappear. For example, if set to 240, when you qualify for a new trait, you'll have a 1 in 240 chance to gain/lose it in the first hour. If it fails, the chance becomes 1 in 239 the next hour, and so on
Sandbox_ETW_DelayedTraitsSystemDefaultSt: Additional delay (in hours) stacked on top of the default delay for 'free' traits obtained at the start of the game. For example, starting with 9 Strength would usually grant Hoarder for free. If the Delayed Traits system is enabled, with a Default Delay of 240 and Additional Delay for Starting Traits of 480, you won't get Hoarder at the start. Instead, it goes into the table with a maximum delay of 720 hours. So, you'll have a 1 in 720 chance to get it in the first hour, and so on
Sandbox_ETW_DelayedTraitsSystem_tooltip:
This system allows you to gain/lose traits in a more random and less predictable way. When you qualify to add/remove a trait, it doesn't happen instantly. Instead, it's added to a table with a delay in hours (based on sandbox settings below). Every hour, the game rolls to determine if you gain/lose each trait in this table (each trait is rolled separately). You have a 1 in X chance to gain/lose the trait every hour. If the roll fails, X is reduced by 1. So the longer you go, the higher the chances that the trait you earned will manifest.
Technical note: Traits that rely on skill levels will be unlocked as described above. However, traits that rely on internal counters added by this mod (e.g., Prone To Illness, Weak Stomach, Outdoorsman, Cat Eyes, etc.) will unlock the next time their internal counters increase. This is because coding a separate unlock mechanism for these specific traits would be complex and unnecessary. For example, if you qualify for Cat Eyes and it's added to the Delayed Traits Table, you won't get it immediately. Instead, you'll get it as soon as the Cat Eyes counter increases next time (e.g., the closest evening/night).
Sandbox_ETW_EagleEyedDistance_tooltip: At what distance must a zombie be to count this as a kill to Eagle-Eyed kill counter. For vanilla would recommend leaving at 20, for mods that add good firearms (Gunfighter + Brita for example), would recommend setting to 25 or so
Sandbox_ETW_EatingSpeedSystemCounter_too: Total base duration value from completed food-eating actions required to gain Fast Eater. Slow Eater can be lost after half this value. Interrupted actions do not count, and eating-speed traits do not change the amount recorded.
Sandbox_ETW_EatingSpeedSystem_tooltip: Tracks the base duration values of completed food-eating actions. Interrupted eating actions, drinking, and smoking do not count. At half of the configured counter you can lose Slow Eater; at the full counter you can gain Fast Eater.
Sandbox_ETW_FastEaterSpeed_tooltip: Percentage by which the Fast Eater trait reduces the time needed to eat food. Does not affect drinking or smoking. Set to 0 to disable the speed bonus.
Sandbox_ETW_FearOfLocationsExclusiveFear: If enabled, you will only ever have Claustrophobic OR Agoraphobic, whichever has the lower counter
Sandbox_ETW_FearOfLocationsSystemCounter: Fear Of Locations Counter Decrease Multiplier

Controls how fast the counter decreases when you are unhappy (50%%+) or stressed (50%%+). Since you are more often normal than unhappy or stressed, it's recommended not to set this value too low. The formula for how much the counter decreases every minute is: 1 * (1 + unhappiness(0-1)) + (1 * stress(0-1)) * multiplier. At minimum, you lose 0 * multiplier; at maximum, you lose 4 * multiplier

Counter = amount of minutes you need to spend outside/inside to lose the respective trait, Agoraphobic or Claustrophobic. Being outside/inside when stressed or unhappy will decrease the counter. Reaching a negative counter value will GAIN you the appropriate trait. Reaching a positive counter value will get rid of the appropriate trait, being in between -counter and +counter will result in no change. The lower boundary is -2x of the counter, and the upper boundary is 2x of the set value here
Sandbox_ETW_FearOfLocationsSystemPassive: Fear of Locations Passive Counter Decay

If you have an issue managing both Agoraphobic and Claustrophobic traits simultaneously, you can set up passive decay using this option. This slowly decays the opposite counter based on whether you're outside/inside every minute, regardless of your mental state. For example, setting this to 0.1 and being inside will gradually reduce your fear of outside by adding 0.1 to the outside counter every minute. Setting it to 0 will have no effect on counters. Recommended values range from 0.1 to 0.5
Sandbox_ETW_FirstAidSkill: First Aider First Aid Skill requirement
Sandbox_ETW_FogSystemCounterDecreaseMult: Adjusts the rate at which your counter decreases. See tooltip for details in Fog System Counter
Sandbox_ETW_FogSystemCounterIncreaseMult: Adjusts the rate at which your counter increases. See tooltip for details in Fog System Counter
Sandbox_ETW_FogSystemCounter_tooltip: You gain progress every minute you spend in fog. Being panicked can slow down the process or even revert it. If the counter is below -counter, you gain Homichlophobia; when reaching counter, you gain Homichlophile. If the counter is between these values, there is no effect. Making a kill at during fog triggers extra execution of function responsible for gaining/losing progress (so instead of getting progress 1 time / minute you can get progress 3 times per minute, for example)
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSicknessSystemCounter_to: Determines how much food sickness you need to accumulate to lose/gain Food Sickness-related traits, Weak Stomach and Iron Gut. Sickness can range from 0 to 1, where 1 can lead to death. Each minute, your current food sickness level is added to the counter.
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSicknessSystemNormalSick: Sickness gained specifically from food and general sickness are different things in the game. This multiplier allows normal sickness to count for gaining the Food Sickness System traits.
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSystemGainNegativeThresh: If your 31-day average food score drops to or below this value, you can gain Hearty Appetite. Lower values make the system more forgiving.
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSystemGainPositiveThresh: If your 31-day average food score rises to or above this value, you can gain Light Eater. Higher values make it harder to gain. Food scores range from 0 to 1, where higher is better.
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSystemLoseNegativeThresh: If your 31-day average food score rises to or above this value, you can lose Hearty Appetite. Higher values make it harder to recover from the negative trait.
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSystemLosePositiveThresh: If your 31-day average food score drops to or below this value, you can lose Light Eater. Lower values make the positive trait harder to lose.
Sandbox_ETW_FoodSystem_tooltip: Tracks your long-term eating habits using rolling averages, similar to the mental system. The mod stores a normalized food score over time, where higher is better. Staying reasonably fed over time helps you lose Hearty Appetite and eventually gain Light Eater. Frequently letting hunger stay high for long periods pushes you toward Hearty Appetite. Sleeping time is ignored so the system judges habits rather than sleep cycles.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemCounter_tooltip: Sets both the positive and negative limit of the Healer System counter. Gain Slow Healer at -66%%, lose Slow Healer at -33%%, lose Fast Healer at +33%%, and gain Fast Healer at +66%%. Characters who start with Slow Healer or Fast Healer begin at the corresponding negative or positive maximum.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemNeedsAttentionMu: Multiplies severity-weighted Healer System progress lost from wounds that need attention. The system checks every in-game minute and applies one tenth of the configured ten-minute total each time. Wound severity is configured with the shared Body Contribution settings.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemProperlyTendedMu: Multiplies severity-weighted Healer System progress from properly tended wounds. The system checks every in-game minute and applies one tenth of the configured ten-minute total each time. Wound severity is configured with the shared Body Contribution settings.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystem_tooltip: Controls Slow Healer and Fast Healer based on how consistently the character tends current wounds. Wound care is checked every in-game minute. Clean bandages, stitches, and valid splints add severity-weighted progress; dirty bandages, embedded glass or bullets, untreated bleeding, burns needing washing, uncovered wounds, and splintable fractures without a splint remove it. Contribution settings describe the total progress produced over ten in-game minutes when the wound state remains unchanged. Wound infection is not counted, and having no tracked wounds does not change the counter.
Sandbox_ETW_HearingSystemSkill_tooltip: Determines how many levels in Agility + Combat (excluding Maintenance) you need to obtain/lose hearing-related perks (Hard Of Hearing and Keen Hearing). You lose Hard of Hearing when you surpass half of the required levels and gain Keen Hearing upon reaching the specified number
Sandbox_ETW_HerbalistHerbsPicked_tooltip: Specifies how many herbs you need to pick up through foraging to gain the permanent Herbalist trait
Sandbox_ETW_HerbalistJournalCounterIncre: Determines the percentage of the maximum Herbalist counter added the first time a character reads The Herbalist journal. This bonus can only be received once. For example, if the maximum counter is 1000 and this is set to 50%%, reading the journal adds 500 points
Sandbox_ETW_HoarderCounter_tooltip: Determines how much inventory-fullness progress is required to gain Hoarder. Progress is added every in-game minute based on carried weight divided by maximum carry weight: a full inventory adds 1 point, while a half-full inventory adds 0.5 points
Sandbox_ETW_HoarderWeight: Hoarder Bonus weight per point of Strength
Sandbox_ETW_HomichlophileMultiplier_tool: Determines how much Homichlophile affects the player. The formula for stress and panic decrease every minute you're in fog is: 4%% * fogIntensity * Homichlophile Multiplier. Fog intensity ranges from 0 to 1, so the full 4%% decrease is rare
Sandbox_ETW_HomichlophobiaMultiplier_too: Determines how much Homichlophobia affects the player. The formula for stress and panic increase every minute you're in fog is: 4%% * fogIntensity * Homichlophobia Multiplier. Fog intensity ranges from 0 to 1, so the full 4%% increase is rare
Sandbox_ETW_HunterSkill_tooltip: Sneaking + Aiming + Small Blade + Tracking + Butchering. Additional requirement is to have at least 2 levels in each skill.
Sandbox_ETW_ImmunitySystemCounter_toolti: Upon reaching the half of value on this counter you lose Prone to Illness, upon reaching the value you gain Resilient. Every minute current cold strength is added to the counter. Being infected with Knox Infection also contributes to counter (so if you run mods that can help you fight infection, like Antibodies, it will help with Immunity System)
Sandbox_ETW_ImmunitySystemInfectionMulti: This is multiplier how much Knox infection level contributes to Immunity System progress.
Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystemCounter_toolti: Sets both the positive and negative limit of the Injuries System counter. Trait thresholds are percentages of this value: gain Thin Skinned at -66%%, lose Thin Skinned at -33%%, lose Thick Skinned at +33%%, and gain Thick Skinned at +66%%. Characters who start with Thin Skinned or Thick Skinned begin at the corresponding negative or positive maximum.
Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystemPassiveCounter: How much is subtracted from the Injuries System counter every ten in-game minutes while the character has none of the tracked injuries.
Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystem_tooltip:
Controls Thin Skinned and Thick Skinned based on the injuries your character sustains over time. Every ten minutes, each current tracked injury increases the counter by its configured contribution, fortifying the character over time. Having no tracked injuries instead decreases the counter. Wound infection does not contribute. The counter is clamped between the negative and positive maximum.
Thin Skinned is gained at -66%%, Thin Skinned is lost at -33%%, Thick Skinned is lost at +33%%, and Thick Skinned is gained at +66%%.

Disorganized: 66%% of Weight counter and 33%% of Items counter
Organized: 100%% of Weight counter and 66%% of Items counter

Sandbox_ETW_MechanicsRepairs_tooltip: The percentage of car condition you have to repair to qualify for the perk. Works on every part of a car and is saved between all cars
Sandbox_ETW_OutdoorsmanCounterDecreaseMu: Adjusts the rate at which you lose points from the outdoorsman counter. For example, multiplier of 0.25 means you'd be losing 25%% of points.
Sandbox_ETW_OutdoorsmanCounterIncreaseMu: Adjusts the rate at which you gain points in outdoorsman counter. For example, multiplier of 2.5 means you'd be gaining 250%% of points'.

The harsher the weather, the faster you'll accumulate points towards gaining the trait. Conversely, staying indoors gradually reduces progress. You gain the trait when the counter reaches its specified threshold, and lose it when dropping below the opposite threshold. Being inside will slowly start to decrease the counter, with maximum decrease being reached after being indoors/in-car for 900 min. Killing while outside will also progress the counter based on weather.
Sandbox_ETW_PainToleranceCounter_tooltip: Every 10 minutes your pain (0-100) is added to counter. Upon reaching counter you'll get Pain Tolerance trait
Sandbox_ETW_PainToleranceThreshold_toolt: Sets the maximum pain level your character can reach while benefiting from this perk

Sandbox_ETW_PetTherapyUniqueAnimalsPette: How many different animals you have to pet to qualify for gaining Pet Therapy
Sandbox_ETW_PluviophileMultiplier_toolti: Multiplies the effects of Unhappiness, Stress, and Boredom decreases
Sandbox_ETW_PluviophobiaMultiplier_toolt: Multiplies the effects of Unhappiness, Stress, and Boredom increases
Sandbox_ETW_RainSystemCounterDecreaseMul: Adjusts the rate at which your Rain System Counter decreases, detailed in Rain System Counter tooltip
Sandbox_ETW_RainSystemCounterIncreaseMul: Adjusts the rate at which your Rain System Counter increases, detailed in Rain System Counter tooltip
Sandbox_ETW_RainSystemCounter_tooltip: You gain progress every minute you spend in rain while outside. Being panicked can slow down the process or even revert it. If the counter is below -counter, you gain Pluviophobia; when reaching counter, you gain Pluviophile. If the counter is between these values, there is no effect. Sandbox_ETW_ReaderSystemCounter_tooltip: Determines how many pages you need to read to lose Slow Reader and gain Fast Reader. Sandbox_ETW_RestorationExpertChance_tool: %% chance to not increase the number of times an item was repaired after a repair
Sandbox_ETW_ServerLogs_tooltip: (MP ONLY) If enabled, prints some debug information into server console/logs. Should not be enabled unless there's incorrect mod behavior and you are reporting a bug
Sandbox_ETW_SewerUniqueClothesRipped_too: Amount of unique clothing you need to rip to qualify for Sewer. If you are running with modded clothes, increase this respectively. AuthenticZ or Brita Armor Pack all add A LOT of clothing to rip, as an example.
Sandbox_ETW_SleepMoodle_tooltip: If this option is disabled, the moodle won't show up. For single-player, leave this on and change moodles you see with Mod Options. If it's a server setting, players won't be able to enable the moodle client-sided
Sandbox_ETW_SleepSystemMultiplier_toolti: Determines how fast you increase/decrease the SleepHealthiness counter, which dictates if you get/lose Wakeful and Sleepyhead. Higher values mean faster gain and loss. Lower values mean slower gain and loss
Sandbox_ETW_SleepSystem_tooltip:
Enables obtaining/losing sleep-related traits, Wakeful and Sleepyhead.
---General description---
Mod tracks at which hours you like to sleep, and as long as you sleep within around those hours, you reinforce your healthy sleep schedule. If you sleep outside of it, you lose some schedule integrity. Not sleeping for more than 24 hours also starts to damage your sleep schedule. Mod tracks at which hours you like to sleep by checking the midpoint of your last sleep, so it's possible to shift your schedule to different hours.
---Technical description, don't read this if you don't want to meta-game much---
Every time you sleep, the mod tracks the midpoint of your sleep. For example, if you sleep between 23:00 and 05:30, the midpoint would be 03:45, and it would be your optimal sleeping hour. If you sleep within +-6 hours of this time, you gain progress to your SleepHealthiness bar, which ranges from -200 to 200. A check is made every 10 minutes, adding +0.167 to the bar if sleeping within the correct schedule, essentially giving +1 for every hour of correct sleep. Sleeping outside this schedule removes 0.167 from the bar every 10 minutes. After not sleeping for more than 24 hours, you start losing -0.167 every ten minutes. If your bar falls below -100, you get Sleepyhead. If it's above 100, you get Wakeful. Starting with either trait sets the starting value of the bar to its maximum or minimum point: +200 for Wakeful and -200 for Sleepyhead
Sandbox_ETW_SlowEaterSpeed_tooltip: Percentage by which the Slow Eater trait increases the time needed to eat food. Does not affect drinking or smoking. Set to 0 to disable the slowdown.
Sandbox_ETW_SmokerCounter_tooltip:
Upon reaching this value on the counter, you'll get the Smoker trait. When dropping to the opposite of it, you'll lose it. Counter boundaries are -2x the counter to 2x the counter.

How it works: Every smoke you take increases your addiction counter. The longer breaks you take between smokes, the less the increase. Smoking while being panicked or stressed increases the counter much faster, based on the level of panic and stress. Not smoking slowly decays the counter. Being panicked or stressed slows the decay rate
Sandbox_ETW_SmokingAddictionDecay_toolti: Determines how fast your addiction decays
Sandbox_ETW_SmokingAddictionMultiplier_t: Determines how fast your addiction increases
Sandbox_ETW_StickFighterKills: Stick Fighter Short Blunt Kills requirement
Sandbox_ETW_StickFighterSkill: Stick Fighter Short Blunt Skill requirement
Sandbox_ETW_ThirstSystemGainNegativeThre: If your 31-day average thirst score drops to or below this value, you can gain High Thirst. Lower values make the system more forgiving.
Sandbox_ETW_ThirstSystemGainPositiveThre: If your 31-day average thirst score rises to or above this value, you can gain Low Thirst. Higher values make it harder to gain. Thirst scores range from 0 to 1, where higher is better.
Sandbox_ETW_ThirstSystemLoseNegativeThre: If your 31-day average thirst score rises to or above this value, you can lose High Thirst. Higher values make it harder to recover from the negative trait.
Sandbox_ETW_ThirstSystemLosePositiveThre: If your 31-day average thirst score drops to or below this value, you can lose Low Thirst. Lower values make the positive trait harder to lose.
Sandbox_ETW_ThirstSystem_tooltip: Tracks your long-term hydration habits using rolling averages, similar to the mental system. The mod stores a normalized thirst score over time, where higher is better. Staying reasonably hydrated over time helps you lose High Thirst and eventually gain Low Thirst. Frequently letting thirst stay high for long periods pushes you toward High Thirst. Sleeping time is ignored so the system judges habits rather than sleep cycles.
Sandbox_ETW_TraitsLockSystemCanGainNegat: If this is enabled, you can gain negative traits during gameplay. This mostly applies to systems that dynamically manage paired positive and negative traits
Sandbox_ETW_TraitsLockSystemCanGainPosit: If this is enabled, you can gain positive traits during gameplay. This applies to a lot of traits; you DO NOT want to have this disabled
Sandbox_ETW_TraitsLockSystemCanLoseNegat: If this is enabled, you can lose negative traits during gameplay. This applies to dynamic trait systems and a number of simple traits
Sandbox_ETW_TraitsLockSystemCanLosePosit: If this is enabled, you can lose positive traits during gameplay. This mostly applies to systems that dynamically manage paired positive and negative traits
Sandbox_ETW_UIPage_tooltip: Enables the Vitals, Permanent Traits, and Non-permanent Traits progress tabs on the ETW character page. The Help and Translations Status tabs remain available when this is disabled.
Sandbox_ETW_WildernessKnowledgeSkill_too: Foraging + Knapping + Maintenance + Carving. Additional requirement is to have at least 2 levels in each skill.
